macros.name: propositionintersect
macros.doc: \propositionintersect uses \sphereintersect[⟨options⟩]{⟨n⟩}{⟨code⟩} to fill the area between the parabola and the outside edge of the ⟨n⟩-th sphere.

macros.name: propositionplot
macros.doc: \propositionplot[⟨options⟩]{⟨direction⟩}{⟨n⟩}{⟨width⟩}{⟨length⟩} produces the plot code for a proposition intersecting the ⟨n⟩-th layer in angle ⟨direction⟩ away from the center of the sphere system, with endpoints ⟨length⟩ away from the center at an angle of ⟨direction⟩ ± ⟨width⟩/2.

macros.name: spherepos
macros.doc: \spherepos{⟨direction⟩}{⟨n⟩}{⟨code⟩} moves to a position in the center of layer ⟨n⟩ in ⟨direction⟩ and then executes TikZ path code ⟨code⟩.
